'''Stamford''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|s|t|æ|m|f|ər|d}}) is a city in [[Fairfield County, Connecticut]], United States, {{convert|34|mi|km|abbr=off|sp=us}} outside of [[New York City]]. It is the sixth-most populous city in [[New England]]. Stamford is also the largest city in the [[Western Connecticut Planning Region, Connecticut|Western Connecticut Planning Region]], and Connecticut's second-most populous city, behind [[Bridgeport, Connecticut|Bridgeport]]. With a population of 135,470, Stamford surpassed [[Hartford, Connecticut|Hartford]] and [[New Haven, Connecticut|New Haven]] in population as of the [[2020 United States census|2020 census]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/stamfordcityconnecticut |title=census.gov |access-date=October 1, 2018 |archive-date=October 2, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181002020447/https://www.census.gov/quickfacts/stamfordcityconnecticut |url-status=live }}</ref> It is in the [[Greater Bridgeport|Bridgeport–Stamford–Danbury metropolitan statistical area]], which is part of the [[New York metropolitan area|New York City metropolitan area]] (specifically, the New York–Newark, NY–NJ–CT–PA Combined Statistical Area).

As of 2023, Stamford is home to eight [[Fortune 500|''Fortune'' 500]] companies<ref name="fortune">{{cite web |url=https://fortune.com/fortune500/2019/search/?hqcity=Stamford |title=Fortune 500 companies in Stamford |date=March 29, 2019 |work=Fortune |access-date=August 28, 2019 |archive-date=February 27, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210227065454/https://fortune.com/fortune500/2019/search/?hqcity=Stamford |url-status=live }}</ref> and numerous divisions of large corporations.<ref>{{cite web |last=Schott |first=Paul |date=June 21, 2019 |title=ITV America Stamford production hub set for 2020 opening |url=https://www.stamfordadvocate.com/business/article/ITV-America-Stamford-production-hub-set-for-2020-14028514.php |access-date=July 10, 2020 |website=Stamford Advocate |archive-date=July 10, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200710182817/https://www.stamfordadvocate.com/business/article/ITV-America-Stamford-production-hub-set-for-2020-14028514.php |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Schott |first=Paul |date=May 25, 2018 |title=ITV and startup announce Stamford hub, plan hundreds of jobs |url=https://www.stamfordadvocate.com/business/article/ITV-and-startup-announce-Stamford-hub-plan-12943555.php |access-date=July 10, 2020 |website=Stamford Advocate |archive-date=July 11, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180711004959/https://www.stamfordadvocate.com/business/article/ITV-and-startup-announce-Stamford-hub-plan-12943555.php |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name=":0" /> This gives it the largest [[financial centre|financial district]] in the New York metropolitan region outside New York City and one of the nation's largest concentrations of corporations. Dominant sectors of Stamford's economy include [[financial services]], [[real estate]], [[tourism]], [[information technology]], [[Health care in the United States|healthcare]], [[telecommunications]], [[Transportation in the United States|transportation]], and [[retail]].<ref>{{Cite news|last=Harris|first=Paul|date=February 15, 2013|title=Connecticut's wealthy Gold Coast: where life is good, if you can afford it|language=en-GB|work=The Guardian|url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/feb/15/connecticut-gold-coast-life-afford|access-date=July 10, 2020|issn=0261-3077|archive-date=July 10, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200710180743/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/feb/15/connecticut-gold-coast-life-afford|url-status=live}}</ref> Its metropolitan division is home to multiple colleges and universities including [[University of Connecticut|UConn Stamford]] and [[Norwalk Community College]].
